name: 85019 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85019 (Phoenix) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (83% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85019 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85019 (Phoenix) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26% of the typical level).
